subject: Consolidation + scale: Streamline renewal & performance proof request
messages:
From: Katie Lopez <katie@streamline.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-08-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Consolidation talks + benchmark request

Karthik —

Thanks for the call earlier. Quick recap and ask from our side: Streamline is coming up for renewal across three product teams (Search, Recommendations, Support). Our CTO wants a single-vendor consolidation if performance and unit cost are equal or better than our current mix. We received a CloudServe PoC report that shows lower per-token cost for short sequences and claims better 99th percentile latency at our 512 token profile.

Two asks to make a decision: 1) a short benchmark showing throughput and 99/95/50 latency on our 512- and 2048-token workloads using our sample corpus; 2) a draft commercial proposal that shows term pricing for a consolidated Dedicated pool (expected steady-state ~75M tokens/month, peak bursts to 250M).

We have a procurement timeline: intent to award by 2028-08-24, procurement kickoff immediately after. Can Redwood commit to a light PoV next week?

Also looping in procurement for availability.

Thanks,
Katie
Katie Lopez
VP, Platform Engineering
Streamline Analytics

Attachment: sample-corpus-aug2028.tar.gz (referenced)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Katie Lopez <katie@streamline.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-08-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidation talks + benchmark request

Hi Katie —

Appreciate the clarity and the timeline. We can run a focused benchmark and put together a consolidation proposal. Proposed approach:

- Quick onboarding call tomorrow to confirm test corpus slices and SLOs (512/2048 length mixes).
- 3-day PoV run on a dedicated staging pool that mirrors your expected peak config; we'll publish per-route latency percentiles and cost-per-1M tokens for your slices.
- Commercial: draft reserved capacity and burst plan (monthly commit + overage) with a 12/24-month term comparison.

As a courtesy, we'll provide a one-time pilot credit against the first month for the PoV. Can you share the corpus link and an internal recipient for the staging credentials?

Cc-ing Marissa (Customer Success) and Jordan (Solutions) to align on logistics.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Sales — Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-08-15T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidation talks + benchmark request

Team —

A couple of notes before we lock the PoV run:

- The CloudServe report calls out a <18ms 99th claim at 512 tokens. We should capture the same metrics but also highlight end-to-end request variance and cold-starts under burst.
- Ask Streamline for representative backing traffic: %chat vs %embed vs %completion; that will determine batching & KV cache config.
- We should include a short regression check against a saved prompt set (10 canonical queries) so customers can sanity-check quality parity during the PoV. If they see hallucinations, it derails the consolidation quickly.

I'll prepare our benchmark template (v2) and a short checklist for security/compliance asks to speed procurement. Marcus — need an estimated footprint and preliminary cost delta for the 75M steady / 250M burst profile.

-M

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-08-16T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidation talks + benchmark request

Hi all —

Attached is a short config snippet and our recommended PoV topology. Summary:

- Recommend Dedicated pool sized as 4 x A10-equivalent instances for the 75M steady state, with autoscale headroom for bursts up to 250M (burst policy: +2 instances, warm-cache warmup).
- Model profile: keep their preferred open model (we'll mirror the architecture used in their CloudServe test) with q4_K quantization; sequence-length aware batching to avoid throughput loss at 512 tokens.
- Expect estimated unit cost ~6-9% higher than the CloudServe headline on short sequences, but our caching and batching should reduce effective cost on chat-heavy workloads by ~12-18%. We'll capture this in the PoV report.
- Latency targets (expected): 50th ~8-12ms, 95th ~25-35ms, 99th ~40-65ms depending on burst and cold-start. We'll surface real numbers from the run.

Attachment: redwood-configuration-snippet.txt (text, 2.3 KB)

I'll sync with infra to schedule the staging pool for Mon/Tue next week — will confirm wall-clock windows shortly.

—Marcus
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Katie Lopez <katie@streamline.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, Procurement <procurement@streamline.ai>
Date: 2028-08-17T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood PoV plan + consolidated commercial outline (Streamline)

Katie —

Thanks again for the context. Per our plan, attached is a concise PoV & benchmark plan (benchmark-plan-v2.pdf) and a commercial term sheet (redwood-pricing-term-sheet.pdf). Highlights:

- PoV: 3 full days of controlled runs across 512/2048 profiles, plus a 10-query quality regression set. We'll publish latency percentiles, throughput, and effective cost per 1M tokens for your mixes.
- Pilot credit: $15k credit back against first month if you convert to Dedicated within 30 days of PoV completion.
- Commercial (summary):
  - 12-month reserved plan: baseline monthly commit 75M tokens at $0.XXX / 1k tokens (see sheet), burst pool priced as pre-agreed headroom.
  - Volume tiers and a 5% discount if you commit to multi-product consolidation across Search + Recs + Support.
  - 30-day SLA ramp for latency commitments after go-live; fallback policy to Hosted instances for unexpected capacity shortfalls during ramp.

Next steps:
1) Confirm PoV start window (we have a Mon/Tue slot open).
2) Share the sample corpus link and the 10 canonical queries for the regression set.
3) Procurement contact to accept draft term sheet (we can lock pricing with an intent-to-proceed note).

Attachments: benchmark-plan-v2.pdf (PDF, 312 KB); redwood-pricing-term-sheet.pdf (PDF, 98 KB)

DocuSign link (provisioning/term sheet): https://www.docusign.com/s/streamline-renewal-S-2028-041

Happy to jump on a 30-minute alignment call after you review.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Sales — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
